How Lane E Parses HTML

By A Keystone Contributor — 2026-04-17

Lane E takes fetched HTML and turns it into structured passages. Every passage keeps a locator pointing at its section.

Sections With Headings

Headings build a chain so downstream evidence can be attributed to a sub-topic. Example: “Risks & Mitigations”.

Lists And Quotes

  • Lists become list_item passages.
  • Nested inline markup is flattened.
“Deterministic parsing is the floor, not the ceiling.”

Closing

No scripts or styles leak into the passage set.

Entities like & and © round-trip correctly.
